meaning: Devices outside the data centre that connect to a cloud service; here, the computer beside each robot arm.
An agent program on each device plus a cloud service that tells that program which software to run.
The AWS service that holds the registry of devices and the message broker they connect to.
AWS IoT's record of one device.
A thing that runs the Greengrass software.
The Greengrass agent program on the device, shipped as a Java program or as nucleus lite, a set of small C daemons.
The unit of software Greengrass delivers: a recipe file that says how to install and start it, plus its artifacts.
The JSON or YAML file that names a component, its dependencies, its artifacts and its lifecycle commands.
A file or container image a component needs, named in its recipe.
The full list of components a thing or thing group should run; it stands, so a device that reconnects later still receives it.
A named set of things, the target of a fleet deployment.
A small JSON document per thing kept in the cloud, holding desired state, reported state and their difference.
An AWS IoT remote operation sent to devices; it carries a group deployment and controls its rate, abort rule and timeout.
Updating a few devices first, widening as successes are reported and stopping when too many fail.
A small set of devices that takes an update before the rest of the fleet.
A Greengrass deployment that targets a smaller group of devices inside a parent deployment's group.
A job rule that cancels the queued part of a rollout once a set percentage of devices has failed.
The Greengrass component that trades the device certificate for short-lived AWS credentials that other components use.
The AWS service whose roles say which AWS services a device's components may call.
AWS's store for container images.
A lightweight protocol in which a device publishes small messages to named topics and subscribers receive them.
A Greengrass component that queues data on the device and exports it in the background, including files to Amazon S3.
Sending one S3 object as many parts, so a dropped connection costs one part.
A policy model that reads camera images and a written instruction and outputs motor commands.
One recorded attempt at the task, stored as rows of joint data plus video files.

expansion: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service Hybrid Nodes
meaning: A feature that joins a machine on your premises to a cloud Kubernetes cluster as a worker node.
AWS's label for environments whose network link is unreliable.
Onboarding many devices by shipping each with a shared claim certificate that it exchanges for its own on first connection.
